name: The Pencil Forest
description: A surreal forest of giant colored pencils grows like trees among eraser boulders and shaving paths.
prompt: Surreal forest of giant colored pencils growing like trees, eraser boulders, curly pencil-shaving path, sharpened tips touching a pastel sky, sunlight filtering through, tiny hikers for scale, detailed whimsical illustration, no text, no logos.
caption: A forest where every tree has a point. ✏️🌲
